message.content:
This vertical, rectangular editorial illustration features an aerial, high-angle view of a densely crowded urban area. A massive group of people, primarily dressed in white, fills the streets and surrounds a circular fountain. The fountain has multiple small jets and one tall central spray. High-rise buildings and skyscrapers in various shades of grey, white, and brown stand in the background against a pale, overcast sky. A line of green trees borders the road on the left.

The image is overlaid with text. At the top, yellow stylized script reads "Hikayat 45 Danau Indonesia" below "LIPUTAN KHUSUS" in thin, white capital letters. Large, bold white letters spell "TEMPO" across the upper-middle section. In the center, "4 NOVEMBER 2016" is printed in large, bold white capital letters. A red vertical bar runs down the left edge. A small logo with yellow and red shapes and "1971-2016" is near the top left. The bottom left contains a barcode and text including "7-13 NOVEMBER 2016" and "RP 45.000". Small, thin white text is visible below "TEMPO."
